about: The drive's landmarks (server/landmarks.py). buildings: matched by OSM id (osm, Overture's src_record without its version: a building or a building part) or by a point its footprint holds (at; part: true matches a building part). An OSM-matched building keeps its OSM outline and parts over DRCOG's roofprints; give it an 'at' (its centroid) too, which names the map cells it is cached in. set: attributes over the map's (height, min_height, roof_shape, roof_height, roof_look, facade_look, lantern [r, h], stadium, canopy, seat_rgb, class). drop: leave the footprint out (a placed piece stands for it). pieces: shapes placed by latitude and longitude (kind dome, spire, star; base_m over the ground there). Ids and centroids from OpenStreetMap (Overpass, 2026-10-28).
